svg.title: QP2609 Q4 - D6: WinGD Pulse Jet (Pulse Lubricating System) - functional block diagram, separate maker
svg.desc: A different maker's system, not part of the Everllence installation. Engine-wide parts, one set per engine: cylinder oil from the service tank or tanks, by gravity or a supply pump, enters at engine inlet 33 through a duplex oil filter and runs along the engine in a rail to every cylinder; where the optional iCAT (integrated Cylinder lubricant Auto Transfer system) is fitted, a second, high-BN inlet 32 with its own duplex filter and rail is added. Per cylinder, drawn once as a representative cylinder: the iCAT change-over valve near the lubricating pump selects rail 33 or rail 32 and feeds the pump; without iCAT, rail 33 feeds the pump directly. The pump is operated by servo oil from the engine-wide mini-rail; the engine control system commands its solenoid valve, reads a pressure transmitter and controls the iCAT. Quills with non-return valves inject oil whose distribution above, into and below the ring pack is set by control-system timing parameters. The piston-underside drain is sampled for residual BN and iron and the operator adjusts the feed rate.
svg.text: Q4 - D6 WinGD Pulse Jet / Pulse Lubricating System (PLS) - a DIFFERENT maker's alternative
NOT part of the Everllence B&W installation in D1-D5. Functional blocks only: WinGD does not publish the pump's internal hydraulics.
